target: def Target : Prop := ∀ φ : Form, Def15 ∅ φ → Def15 ∅ (K φ)
a_raw: {"translation":"Target is defined to be the following proposition: for every formula φ, if φ is derivable by Def15 from the empty set of hypotheses, then K φ is also derivable by Def15 from the empty set of hypotheses. Both derivations may use Def14 axioms and modus ponens, but no hypotheses. There is no separate requirement that φ be closed or be an axiom. The implication is between derivability claims; it does not ask for a derivation of the formula imp φ (K φ), and it does not quantify over nonempty hypothesis sets."}
translation: Target is defined to be the following proposition: for every formula φ, if φ is derivable by Def15 from the empty set of hypotheses, then K φ is also derivable by Def15 from the empty set of hypotheses. Both derivations may use Def14 axioms and modus ponens, but no hypotheses. There is no separate requirement that φ be closed or be an axiom. The implication is between derivability claims; it does not ask for a derivation of the formula imp φ (K φ), and it does not quantify over nonempty hypothesis sets.

judgement.summary: Target expresses the rule p / Bp as closure of theoremhood under K: if φ is derivable from the axioms alone, so is Kφ. It does not extend the rule to derivations that use extra hypotheses.
